items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: when we had one fella playing a clarinet named Ezebri Zanaris.

ctx.x: Yeah sure you'd improve. I wondered though.

And then we had different ideas you know. Better ideas. You know how to make different own arrangements like that and practicing. And we used to get to... Oh Graff one I believe we called it you know. And something come out like that where the other bands would be playing. But we would just have a practice like that. We called it special practice when we had one fella playing a clarinet named Ezebri Zanaris. Lana Rees. And he could catch those records. He played C clarinet. And he could catch those records.
